hints.text: The degree of a polynomial is the BIGGEST exponent that appears on $x$.
The terms have exponents $3$, $1$, and $0$ (the plain number). Pick out the largest of those three.
The largest exponent is $3$, so the degree of $p(x)$ is $3$.

explanation: Look at the power of $x$ in every term: $x^3$, then $x$ to the first power, then the plain number $7$.
The degree is the highest of those powers, and the highest one here is $3$.
So the degree of the polynomial is $3$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the biggest one wins
steps: Plug in a huge number like $x = 100$.
The biggest exponent bosses the whole graph around, so it names the degree.
